title: C_SeedRandom returns wrong error code
description:
C_SeedRandom returns CKR_RANDOM_SEED_NOT_SUPPORTED (0x00000120) but pkcs11test expects CKR_RANDOM_NO_RNG (0x00000121) when seeding is not supported.

Per PKCS#11 spec section 11.15, when a token does not have/use a seeding mechanism, C_SeedRandom should return CKR_RANDOM_NO_RNG. CKR_RANDOM_SEED_NOT_SUPPORTED means the operation is valid but seeding is not accepted (different semantic).

wolfP11's C_SeedRandom implementation returns the more specific CKR_RANDOM_SEED_NOT_SUPPORTED. pkcs11test (and SoftHSM2) use CKR_RANDOM_NO_RNG.

Impact: ReadOnlySessionTest.SeedRandom fails.

Fix: change C_SeedRandom to return CKR_RANDOM_NO_RNG instead of CKR_RANDOM_SEED_NOT_SUPPORTED.
